exposure: dinoprostone vaginal insert for cervical ripening
cohort: The study included 400 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies, beyond 30 weeks of gestation, with a live fetus in cephalic presentation, undergoing cervical ripening with dinoprostone vaginal insert, comparing outcomes in 200 women with hypertensive disorders (100 with severe preeclampsia) to 200 normotensive women.
finding: Dinoprostone is effective for cervical ripening and labor induction in pregnant women with hypertensive disorders, with obstetric outcomes and effectiveness largely comparable to normotensive pregnant women.
mod_finding: The vaginal delivery rate was similar between patients with hypertensive disorders (44%) and healthy women (55%), with cesarean deliveries mainly attributed to failed ripening and medical decision.
